summary: Iteration 5 verification: frontend-only removals (settings tab, low/out-of-stock analytics cards, reorder + top-movers panels) and new 'Out of stock by brand' section. Backend sanity check passed (dashboard/bootstrap/stock all 200). All frontend expectations verified via Playwright on the public URL.
critical_code_review_comments: Sidebar nav testids for Current Stock and Brands are `nav-stock-button` and `nav-catalog-button` (not `nav-current-stock-button` / `nav-brands-button` as the review request suggested). Not a bug, just a naming inconsistency worth noting for future test authors.
The 'Out of stock by brand' heading is rendered with CSS text-transform:uppercase inside a small kicker/label rather than a real <h2>. Semantic heading would improve accessibility.
seed_data_creation: None — used the pre-existing OUT-000001 (35 Exide 100Ah Tubular) that leaves Exide 100Ah Tubular at 0 available.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified: 6 sidebar items (Dashboard, Current Stock, History, Dealers, Suppliers, Brands) — no Settings. Dashboard has exactly analytics-available (416) and analytics-in-stock (12 of 13). analytics-low-stock / analytics-out-of-stock / order-next-panel / top-movers-panel confirmed ABSENT. 'Fast moving' and 'What to order next' text confirmed ABSENT. 'Out of stock by brand' + 'What's missing per brand' present. Exide brand chip shows red '1 OUT' and expands to a single row (Exide 100Ah Tubular · 0 available · OUT). Massimo & Microtek show green 'HEALTHY' chip; Massimo expand shows compact 'Nothing out of stock for Massimo' healthy state with 'Every model has at least one unit available.' Both analytics cards open data-testid='drill-drawer'. Backend /api/dashboard, /api/bootstrap, /api/stock all return 200 with expected 3 brands / 13 products / 3 dealers / 3 suppliers. Reset endpoint intentionally not exposed in UI — confirmed absent (no reset-all-button).
